title: Beyond Interpretable Benchmarks: Contextual Learning through Cognitive and Multimodal Perception
findings: The paper finds that AI is limited in its cognitive capabilities because it cannot perceive emotions or exercise moral responsibility. It cites religion as a key example of a complex problem domain that is 'unavoidably rooted in individual subjectivity,' which AI systems cannot comprehend or navigate because they lack a personal philosophy, inherent values, and emotional experiences.
